description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nasus''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''bonus''' health, [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor, [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance, increased [[size]], and [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' attack range for the duration.
description.text: Active: Nasus empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining  bonus health,  bonus armor,  bonus magic resistance, increased size, and  50 bonus attack range for the duration.

description2.raw: While '''Nasus''' is empowered, he deals magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies, capped at 240 per second, and ''[[File:Nasus Siphoning Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Nasus#Siphoning Strike|An icon for Nasus's ability Siphoning Strike]] [[Nasus#Siphoning Strike|Siphoning Strike's]]'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is halved.
description2.text: While Nasus is empowered, he deals magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies, capped at 240 per second, and Siphoning Strike's  cooldown is halved.
